description.value: Pita Pit is a national fast-food chain franchise located in Prince George's College Heights neighbourhood, serving customizable pita wraps, salads, and rice bowls made to order from a wide range of ingredients. It offers both takeout and delivery, making it a convenient quick-service stop for cyclists moving through the north end of Prince George. A loyalty rewards app is available for frequent visitors.
